From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Date: 2028-05-04T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Problem accepting supplier portal invite — SSO error

Hi all — I pulled the SP logs and the error looks like a signature validation failure during the SAML response verify step. Summary from the logs:

[2028-05-04T08:48:21Z] SAML Response processing: Signature validation failed - certificate thumbprint mismatch
[2028-05-04T08:48:21Z] Incoming InResponseTo: _abc123...; Issuer: https://idp.novuslogistics.com
[2028-05-04T08:48:21Z] Expected cert fingerprint: A1:B2:C3:...:D4 but assertion signed with F9:8E:...:11

This is consistent with a certificate rotation on Novus' IdP for which the SP metadata has not been updated yet. Two immediate asks for Novus:
1) Can you share the IdP metadata XML (or the new cert fingerprint) so we can validate and update our SP config?
2) If the new cert is already pushed, can you confirm whether you updated the metadata endpoint/metadata URL we use to fetch your metadata?

Temporary mitigations:
- Grace/Monica, as suggested, we'll enable the manual activation code so the vendor can finish onboarding without SSO.
- If Novus can temporarily re-publish the previous cert alongside the new one (or add the new cert to their metadata endpoint), the handshake should succeed without changes on our side.

I've attached a sanitized SAML trace excerpt (saml-trace.txt) that shows the validation failure and the thumbprint mismatch for your IdP team.

Ben Carter
Platform Reliability Engineer — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199

Attachments: saml-trace.txt
From: Darren Cole <darren.cole@novuslogistics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Erin Li <erin.li@novuslogistics.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-04T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Problem accepting supplier portal invite — SSO error

Thanks Ben, Grace — appreciate the quick look.

Our IdP team confirms they rotated the signing certificate during a midnight maintenance at 08:45 PDT and there was a metadata publish step that failed to complete to our metadata URL (we saw a timeout while pushing). We've re-published the metadata with both the old and new certs included and attached the new metadata XML to this message so you can validate immediately (novus-idp-metadata.xml).

We also pushed a rollback to the previous cert on the IdP so we should be back to the prior behavior for the next 5–10 minutes while the metadata propagates — please attempt another activation.

If you still see failures I'll have the IdP team provide a fingerprint and we can coordinate a direct exchange.

Attachments: novus-idp-metadata.xml

—
Darren Cole

Subject: Re: Problem accepting supplier portal invite — SSO error

Hi Darren — quick update and closure.

- We retried the SSO handshake after your rollback and metadata republish; both Erin and Darren were able to complete the supplier activation without errors.
- Monica confirmed the manual activation code path was used for one user, and we've now disabled the temporary code for Novus.
- Ben validated the assertion fingerprint against the recently published metadata and cleared the mismatch.

Thanks for the fast response from your IdP team — everything looks green on our side. If you want, we can coordinate a short postmortem to review the metadata publish failure so this doesn't reoccur.

Closing the ticket but please re-open if anything else crops up.

Best,
